```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(rvest)
library(httr2)
library(purrr)
```


```{r}
imdb_snapshots <- readRDS("data/imdb_snapshots.rds") |>
  as_tibble()

print(imdb_snapshots)

names(imdb_snapshots)
```


```{r}
names(imdb_snapshots)
```


```{r}
rank_changes <- imdb_snapshots |>
  filter(snap_year %in% c(2015, 2022)) |>
  select(title, snap_year, rank) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = snap_year,
    values_from = rank,
    names_prefix = "rank_"
  ) |>
  drop_na() |>
  mutate(rank_change = abs(rank_2015 - rank_2022)) |>
  arrange(desc(rank_change)) |>
  slice_head(n = 10)

rank_changes
```


```{r}
rank_changes <- imdb_snapshots |>
  filter(snap_year %in% c(2015, 2022)) |>
  select(title, snap_year, rank, year) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = snap_year,
    values_from = rank,
    names_prefix = "rank_"
  ) |>
  drop_na() |>
  mutate(
    rank_change = abs(rank_2015 - rank_2022),
    release_decade = (year %/% 10) * 10
  )

rank_changes |>
  group_by(release_decade) |>
  summarise(
    average_rank_change = mean(rank_change)
  ) |>
  arrange(release_decade)
```


```{r}
film_appearances <- imdb_snapshots |>
  count(title, name = "snapshot_count")

film_appearances |>
